# M1-04 — Functional Requirements (FRs) & Acceptance Criteria

## Labels
`docs`, `milestone-1`, `priority-critical`

## Milestone
Milestone 1 — Engineering Foundation & Requirements Baseline

## Tasks
- [ ] Derive functional requirements from stakeholder needs and minimum business capabilities
- [ ] Assign each FR a unique ID (e.g. FR-001) that will remain stable across milestones
- [ ] Record source/stakeholder and priority for each FR
- [ ] Write measurable, testable acceptance criteria for each FR
- [ ] Prioritise the FR list (e.g. MoSCoW or similar, documented)
- [ ] Cross-check FRs against Requester / Staff / Management capabilities in the Master Project Brief
- [ ] Add FRs into PED v1.0 and link them into the RTM (M1-07)

## Acceptance Criteria
- Every FR has: unique ID, description, source, priority, and acceptance criteria.
- Acceptance criteria are testable (measurable pass/fail), not vague ("system should work well").
- FR set covers requester, staff and management capabilities from the brief, or the omission is justified.
- At least one FR can be shown end-to-end: source → FR → acceptance criteria → RTM entry.
